skills.name: source-citation
skills.content:
# Source citation discipline

- Every factual claim that matters gets a source link with a retrieval date.
- Prefer primary sources (specs, repo code, official docs) over summaries.
- Quote exactly when the wording matters; paraphrase otherwise.
- If two sources disagree, report both and say which you trust and why.
- Never present a search snippet as a source; open the document.
